classification: opened failed preconvergence writer trace; four live Apple watchpoints captured bounded lifecycle and CA::Render::Updater::prepare_layer write sites, while unchanged watched-byte stops and non-containing symbol-start windows falsified two sealed integrity assumptions; not a public crop law, unseen transfer, or product-parity claim

openedWriterSites.function: CA::Render::Updater::prepare_layer(CA::Render::Updater::GlobalState&, CA::Render::Updater::LocalState&, CA::Render::LayerNode*, CA::Render::Updater::LayerShapes&, unsigned long long&)
openedWriterSites.interpretationBoundary: These PCs are exact observed write stops on storage reused after the selected object lifetime. prepare_layer and the coherent component sequence make them construction candidates, but the current trace lacks the containing instructions and live operands required to prove the arithmetic or bind every site to the public crop policy.

falsifiedSealedAssumptions.assumption: Every callback from a write-on-modify watchpoint changes the watched eight-byte snapshot.
falsifiedSealedAssumptions.observation: Five of 24 callbacks retained identical before/after bytes, including broad or adjacent writes in BackdropGroup::retain_group_common, BackdropLayer::commit_layer, and Updater::prepare_layer.
falsifiedSealedAssumptions.consequence: The current prospective validator fails closed at writer event bounds. A subsequent preregistration must retain and classify unchanged-byte hardware stops instead of rejecting or silently deleting them.

falsifiedSealedAssumptions.assumption: A 4096-byte window from a resolved symbol start contains every writer stop in that symbol.
falsifiedSealedAssumptions.observation: prepare_layer is 40128 bytes; all nine observed prepare_layer stops are at offsets 14812 through 21956, so zero of nine lie in the retained first 4096 bytes.
falsifiedSealedAssumptions.consequence: The next trace must retain a fixed PC-centered window whose range is required to contain the stop PC and nearby writer instruction.

nextEvidenceBoundary.objective: Capture the exact AArch64 instructions and live operands at the isolated prepare_layer sites, then replay their crop construction without numeric tolerance.

Keep the capture_backdrop code hash, preconvergence pointer chain, watched addresses, Apple input matrix, and production shader unchanged.
